reason: The frozen per-family evidence contains potentially actionable stable improvements and regressions, but it also contains widespread episode-level churn under a decoding path whose Batch1-versus-Batch32 canonical agreement was only 0.78125. A new R3 curriculum cannot be justified until one bounded diagnostic distinguishes reproducible model-state interference from batch-sensitive decoding variation.

diagnostic.scientific_question: Do the decisive family-level gains and harms observed under frozen Batch32 decoding reproduce under deterministic Batch1 decoding for the same already-scored development episodes?
diagnostic.cohort_definition: Before model loading, derive and freeze one manifest containing every TARGET_DEV or RETENTION_SENTINEL episode whose V7/R1/R2 exact-correctness transition is neither 000 nor 111 in the preserved paired results. Preserve episode IDs, roles, families, source-result SHA256 values, manifest SHA256, and expected count. Do not add or remove episodes after generation begins.
diagnostic.execution: Run exactly one deterministic Batch1 inference pass for each of the three frozen checkpoints on the same frozen cohort, using the unchanged tokenizer, target-blind token parser, scorer, prompt contract, max-new-token policy, and model manifests. This is one cross-check diagnostic, not three independently tunable experiments.
outputs: per-episode V7/R1/R2 Batch1 token IDs and exact-correctness transitions
per-family Batch1 net paired fixes for R1-versus-V7 and R2-versus-V7
a machine-readable decision-rule result and terminal receipt

decision_rule.pass: PASS only if all five decisive family sign conditions hold under Batch1 and each checkpoint has at least 0.9375 Batch1-versus-preserved-Batch32 canonical agreement on the frozen diagnostic cohort.
decision_rule.on_pass: Return for a new Governor review with a distinct R3 protocol proposal; do not launch R3 automatically.
decision_rule.on_fail: Stop the targeted-repair approach. Do not propose R3 from the current family-weight evidence.
decision_rule.no_indeterminate_override: A partial run, missing checkpoint, missing episode, identity mismatch, or unscorable output is FAIL for this decision rule and cannot be repaired by changing thresholds or cohort membership after execution.

required_pre_execution_freeze: Freeze the exact diagnostic cohort manifest and its deterministic derivation receipt before model loading.

Bind complete V7, R1-final, and R2-final base-and-adapter manifests; exact decoder, scorer, collector, prompt, argv, environment, runtime cap, source provenance, fresh nonce, output paths, and terminal receipt paths.
Verify local, origin, and RunPod source parity and all model, data, cohort, and executable hashes before model import.
Require fresh non-overwriting outputs, no duplicate live job, and one-shot nonce consumption.
Run CPU-only fail-closed tests for cohort derivation, sign-rule evaluation, threshold immutability, partial-run rejection, and terminal-receipt generation.
review_trigger: One immutable complete or failed V7/R1/R2 serial-decoding flip-replication diagnostic package with the frozen cohort manifest, raw token evidence, family sign results, canonical-agreement results, decision-rule output, source/model identities, and terminal receipt.
